topic: Stock Purchases and Sales: Long and Short
subtopic: Short Selling for Hedging and Liquidity
source_evidence: Short selling is also used by market makers and others to provide liquidity in response to unanticipated demand, or to hedge the risk of an economic long position in the same security or in a related security.
answer: Short selling is not used only to try to profit from a falling stock price. Market makers and others may also sell short to provide liquidity when demand for a security is unexpectedly high. Short selling can also hedge the risk of a long economic position in the same or a related security. A short sale involves selling a stock the investor does not own, typically by borrowing it, and later buying shares to return to the lender.
